name: 37803 · Maryville, TN
findings: ZIP 37803 (Maryville) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37803 (Maryville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37803 (Maryville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
